Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
salem wrote:
>
> cause it wasn't mentioned in the functional card text changes, and if
> it is as the 10th set words it, it's a bit wallpapery.

It's a bit shaky as it stands now. Not useless, but if you're not
really shoveling around Voter Cap you're going to regret it -- and you
give people a means to spend pool carelessly, which is not always in
your best interest.

Also, you have to watch out for things like KRC 3-1 on your prey, who
always has the option to spend up to 2 pool against when you play this
card. He may try to force you into a pool race against your predator,
and while it sounds nice at first to say "screw it, i'll just let him
take his spent pool", if the vote fails you can't voter cap no matter
how much pool your prey spent. Dangerous game.

I do like the card and have used it to good effect in the past, but I
think you really have to be prepared to cover the cost. On the plus
side, it allows a vote deck to more easily avoid table timeouts since
the table may be spending their pool.

(this is really just a test message; let's see if we notice that the
content has been replaced with Folger's Crystals)
